 Hibernian 1-1 Celtic 
 Brian McLauchlin 
BBC Sport Scotland at Easter Road 
 Hibernian head coach Marink Reedijk has covered every inch of his technical area in the opening 30 minutes of this game. 
 Meanwhile Martin O’Neil just a few yards away with hands in his pockets with Shaun Maloney being the more active one in the Celtic dugout.

 'Another chance gone for Hogh' published at 12:19 GMT 12:19 GMT 
 Hibernian 1-1 Celtic 
 Pat Bonner 
Former Celtic goalkeeper on BBC Sportsound 
 Beautiful bit of play in Celtic's own half, one-touch passing between three or four players that created the opportunity to exploit the space behind Hibs' press.
 Kasper Hogh has to take a touch, but the goalkeeper makes a big save. It's another chance gone for him.

 Post published at 12:18 GMT 12:18 GMT 
 Hibernian 1-1 Celtic 
 Here's a look at the goals.
 Owen Elding fired Hibs in front before an own goal from Jason Kerr put Celtic level almost immediately.

 Post published at 16 mins 16 mins 
 Hibernian 1-1 Celtic 
 Referee Ryan Lee and Kasper Hogh have an accidental collision in the centre of the park, which the Celtic man isn't best pleased about.
 Hibs get possession back as a result, but give it straight back.

 GREAT SAVE! published at 15 mins 15 mins 
 Hibernian 1-1 Celtic 
 Kasper Hogh must feel like his goalless run is never going to end.
 Celtic's club-record signing gets free at the back post after more good work from Callum Osmand, but Hibs goalkeeper Raphael Sallinger does well to close the angle and make a good save.
 Image source, SNS

 Post published at 12 mins 12 mins 
 Hibernian 1-1 Celtic 
 Celtic pour forward down the left, but Kasper Hogh can't quite get on the end of Callum Osmand's clever cross.

BBC Sport Scotland at Easter Road 
 It’s clear to see even at this early stage that any cross into either box is going to cause issues with this swirling wind. 
 60 22 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 9 mins 9 mins 
 Hibernian 1-1 Celtic 
 The chances continue to come.
 Kasper Hogh does well to get his head on a Celtic cross from the left, but heads over the top.
 94 50 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 12:09 GMT 12:09 GMT 
 Hibernian 1-1 Celtic 
 Brian McLauchlin 
BBC Sport Scotland at Easter Road 
 Lots of empty seats in the Pat Stanton stand. There is also a big gap behind the goals in the Famous Five stand with the ‘block seven’ group currently banned by the club.

 get involved Get Involved published at 12:09 GMT 12:09 GMT 
 Sam Johnstone was fourth choice at Wolves behind a 40-year-old John Ruddy and shouldn't be anywhere near the Celtic starting lineup. Sinisalo is far from perfect but he would 100% have saved that.
 Chris

 GOAL Hibernian 1-1 Celtic published at 6 mins 6 mins 
 Jason Kerr own goal 
 Two goals inside the first six minutes - Celtic are level!
 It's a corner to the back post and Jason Kerr heads into his own net with no Celtic players anywhere near him.
 462 462 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 5 mins 5 mins 
 Hibernian 1-0 Celtic 
 Almost an immediate response from Celtic.
 Callum McGregor's deflected effort forces Raphael Sallinger into a sharp save.
 90 46 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 12:05 GMT 12:05 GMT 
 Hibernian 1-0 Celtic 
 Pat Bonner 
Former Celtic goalkeeper on BBC Sportsound 
 What a finish from Owen Elding, across the goalkeeper beautifully. Johnstone had no chance.
 But it's all down to the brightness, the cuteness of the free-kick.
 Dane Murray just got caught watching the ball. That's why you need someone standing in front of the ball.
 A perfect start for Hibs.
 116 54 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Schoolboy' defending published at 12:04 GMT 12:04 GMT 
 Hibernian 1-0 Celtic 
 Chris Sutton 
Former Celtic striker on Sky Sports 
 Schoolboy stuff from Celtic, it really is. 
 Excellent thinking from Hibs and boy can Elding finish. 
 177 57 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL Hibernian 1-0 Celtic published at 12:03 GMT 12:03 GMT 
 Owen Elding 
 Hibs strike first with a brilliant goal!
 Joe Newell takes a free-kick quickly, Celtic are fast asleep and Owen Elding smashes a great finish into the far corner.
 The sparsely populated home crowd have something to celebrate.
 521 267 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 2 mins 2 mins 
 Hibernian 0-0 Celtic 
 A bright start for the hosts.
 Thibault Klidje gets the ball down and goes wide to Felix Passlack, whose cross is put over his own cross bar by Liam Scales.
 70 30 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Don't be fooled by blue skies published at 12:01 GMT 12:01 GMT 
 Hibernian 0-0 Celtic 
 Brian McLauchlin 
BBC Sport Scotland at Easter Road 
 The blue skies overhead give a false impression of conditions here at Easter Road. It’s chilly and a strong swirling wind will make this a real test for both sets of players. 
 Hibernian are seeking their first home league win in six months and the errors and slackness in recent weeks have to be eradicated if they are to improve results in front of their own fans.
 Martin O’Neill obviously feels that Kasper Hogh can make an impact today with his recall. His physicality could be crucial today against a team that are really struggling to keep their own goal intact.
